meta.title: ZF Entretien | Window cleaning price from 4 photos
meta.description: Window cleaning, gutter cleaning and house washing in Saint-Colomban, Saint-Jérôme and the Laurentides. Get your price right away from 4 photos.

home.heroTitle: Your window cleaning price from 4 photos
home.heroLead: Take a photo of the front, the back and both sides of your house with your phone. Your price shows up right away, with no home visit.
home.heroArea: Saint-Colomban, Saint-Jérôme and the Laurentides up to Rawdon
home.windowsText: Windows and patio doors, inside and out as you need.
home.houseWashText: Exterior walls of the house washed.
home.minimum: Your final price shows up right away. Prices before taxes.
home.how1: Enter your address and pick your services.
home.how2: Take 4 photos of your house. We show you where to stand for each one.
home.how3: See your price and accept it in one tap. We call you to set the date.
home.planText: Windows cleaned twice a year and gutters cleaned once a year, paid monthly, at a reduced price.
home.areaText: Saint-Colomban, Saint-Jérôme and the Laurentides up to Rawdon. A little farther away? Send your request anyway: we'll confirm whether we can come.

address.title: What is the address of the house?
address.label: Address
address.hint: Start typing, then pick your address from the list.
address.hintManual: Enter the full address: number, street and town.
address.noResults: No address found. You can continue with the address as typed.

photos.title: Take 4 photos of your house
photos.hint: One photo per side, in daylight, standing far enough back to see the whole wall from the ground to the roof.
photos.diagramLabel: Top view: stand where marked to photograph the "{side}" side.
photos.tip_front: Stand in the street or at the end of the driveway, facing the house.
photos.tip_back: Go to the backyard and step back as far as you can. Patio doors must be visible.
photos.tip_left: Facing the house, walk around to the left and step back to see the whole wall.
photos.tip_right: Facing the house, walk around to the right and step back to see the whole wall.

contact.title: Where should we send your price?
contact.consent: I agree that ZF Entretien collects my contact information and the photos of my house to prepare my quote, as described in its <link>privacy policy</link>.

submitting.title: Analyzing your photos
submitting.note: This usually takes less than a minute. Keep this page open.
